name: Hillside Hum
subtitle: Plant, season, bloom
shortDescription: A tiny terraced hill, four seasons and five kinds of building. Find the layout that makes the hill hum: 100 hills, a daily hill and Meadow Run.
longDescription:
Every building on this hill hums at its own pace. Wheat loves summer, orchards love autumn, bees wake in spring, huts and mills keep going through winter. Your job is to decide who goes where.

Pick a seed from the tray and tap a furrow to plant it. Tap a season to see what the hill makes in spring, summer, autumn and winter, and watch the meadow turn from blossom to gold to snow while the little windmills slow down. Neighbours matter: bees like orchards and wheat, mills like wheat, and crowding the same kind side by side costs Hum. Reach the bloom mark to win; the marks near the end of the bar ask for a cleverer layout, and the top star is the best plan that exists.

### 100 Hills In Ten Worlds
Seedling Slope teaches the basics. Hut Row and Mill Race add new kinds. Rocky Terraces block furrows, Sun and Shade change what a plot gives, Pond Meadow cools the summer, Tending Fair lets you double a building's best season, Windy Ridge strips the autumn, Late Frost sleeps through spring, and the Grand Almanac mixes everything. Every hill was checked by our own exact solver: it can be won, and its three-star target is the true best layout.

### A Hill Every Day, And Meadow Run
The Daily hill is the same for everyone on that date and keeps a streak. Meadow Run strings hills together: you have three hearts and a limited number of plantings on each board, so plan before you plant. Your best run is kept.

### Free Charms For Your Home Hill
Stars and bloomed hills earn free coins, only by playing. Spend them on 24 charms for the hill on the home screen: weathervanes, lanterns, banners and little critters. No random boxes, nothing to buy with money.

### Look And Sound
A golden-hour paper diorama in 3D: terracotta roofs, wooden fences, drifting petals, fireflies, leaves and snow, with soft music that breathes and gentle sounds as you plant. Sound, haptics and a calm-motion setting are in Settings. Works offline.

### Free To Play
Hillside Hum is free, with ads: a banner on the menu, a banner beneath the hill and a short break after some hills. Watch optional videos to earn a month without ads, or subscribe to Clear Skies for a monthly price shown in the store. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in your App Store account settings.
